seed_query: Identify major diseases, treatments, diagnostic tests, drugs, symptoms, risk factors, and care organizations in the medical corpus, and explain their concrete relationships.
exploration_queries: Identify diseases and their treatments, complications, and care teams in the medical corpus.
Identify diagnostic tests, biomarkers, symptoms, and the conditions they diagnose in the medical corpus.
Identify drugs and therapies, including indications, side effects, contraindications, and alternatives.
Identify anatomy, genes, risk factors, and prevention or screening relationships in the medical corpus.
Identify clinical organizations, professional roles, patient resources, and their care relationships.
